dEATS:
combine the following and bake at 350 for 5 mins in an oven safe dish:
2/3 c oats
1/2 tbsp brown sugar
1/4 tsp baking soda
3/4 c liquid of your choice
cinnamon
while that’s baking combine:
1/2 mashed banana
1 tsp maple syrup or honey
vanilla extract & cinnamon
take that mixture and add it to the oats & continue baking for another 25!
you can add whatever you like on top! i added coconut whipped cream 🥳

caption: yes i waited in line for over a hour and no i did not get a free bowl BUT let me say @playabowlswestchester is the best acai bowl I’ve had EVER 😳 and that says something because let me tell you I have had plenty of acai bowls from a lot of different places!! i got the pura vida bowl and subbed the granola for cacao nibs 🤩 they had so many options on their menu but i decided to stick with basics, but next time i go i think i NEED to try a banana bowl or maybe a chia bowl or a combo of both??? not sure im very indecisive🤷‍♀️ Acai is a nutrient dense food full of antioxidants that benefit your body and they also contain healthy fats & fiber which all important for your overall health😤😤😤

caption:
spent the weekend enjoying new hampshire with my sister, who i’ve missed a lot surprisingly 😛 i drove up friday, spent saturday at UNH and watching the football team suck, and sat in traffic all day sunday 😡 wish we had more time together but I get to squeeze her in exactly 1 month!!!!
while i had a great time this weekend it definitely wasn’t the easiest mentally ☹️ im still getting used to having to rest my body and not being in constant control of what im eating/how it’s being made. suffering with an ed and bdd SUCKS but we out here doing a lot better than i was 3 years ago 😤🙌🏼🖖🏼
